answer: An agent economy can assign voting power in proportion to tokens locked in a staking contract, with a 30-day withdrawal delay. If an attacker divides 1,000 tokens among agents named ivory, zenith, and umber, their combined voting power remains that of 1,000 tokens: extra identities add no influence. To gain more power, the attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the withdrawal delay.
